findings.current: The Blood Lord’s calm, unguarded confidence.
findings.defect: “Unguarded” reverses the explicit statement that he never lets his guard down.
findings.rationale: 여유롭지만, 결코 방심하지 않는 contrasts ease with vigilance.
findings.replacement: The Blood Lord’s ease—and the fact that he never let his guard down.
findings.source: 여유롭지만, 결코 방심하지 않는 혈주의 태도가.

findings.current: The monster of blood had absorbed all the blood within a dozen yards, devouring the life and strength it contained. He fixed his gaze on me, eyes bright with delight.
findings.defect: A radius of more than ten jang is over a hundred feet, not a dozen yards.
findings.rationale: The shortened distance substantially reduces the reach of his blood absorption.
findings.replacement: The monster of blood had absorbed all the blood within a radius of more than a hundred feet, devouring the life and strength it contained. He fixed his gaze on me, eyes bright with delight.
findings.source: 반경 십여 장에 존재하는 모든 핏물을 흡수하고, 그 안에 담겨 있던 생명력과 힘을 집어삼킨 피의 괴물이 희열 어린 눈빛으로 나를 응시했다.

findings.current: Eyes wide with disbelief, they looked back and forth between the huge holes torn through their bodies and the monster standing dozens of yards away. Then they breathed their last.
findings.defect: Several dozen jang is hundreds of feet, not dozens of yards.
findings.rationale: The distance establishes how far the redirected arrows traveled.
findings.replacement: Eyes wide with disbelief, they looked back and forth between the huge holes torn through their bodies and the monster standing hundreds of feet away. Then they breathed their last.
findings.source: 믿을 수 없다는 듯이 부릅뜬 채, 각자의 몸뚱어리에 새겨진 커다란 구멍과 수십여 장 밖에 우뚝 서 있는 괴물을 번갈아 바라보다가 이승에서의 마지막 숨결을 내뱉었다.

findings.current: The fanatics rushing at us, shouting about martyrdom, and the wave of terror their deaths inspired were even overpowering the effect of One Against a Thousand.
findings.defect: The fear comes from the charging fanatics, not from their deaths.
findings.rationale: 그로 인한 refers to their terrifying charge; the source does not make their deaths the cause.
findings.replacement: The sight of fanatics charging in, shouting about martyrdom, and the wave of fear they stirred up were even overpowering the effect of One Against a Thousand.
findings.source: 순교를 부르짖으며 달려드는 광신도들의 모습이, 그로 인한 공포의 물결이 일기당천의 효과마저 짓누르고 있었다.

findings.current: And at the center of this blood-soaked storm of madness stood a monster whose aura shot through the world like Mount Taishan.
findings.defect: The draft makes the monster stand still while his aura shoots outward; the source has the monster hurtling forward with mountain-like momentum.
findings.rationale: 쏘아지는 describes the monster’s movement, while 태산과도 같은 기세 describes its force.
findings.replacement: And at the center of this blood-soaked storm of madness, a monster came hurtling forward with the momentum of Mount Taishan.
findings.source: 그리고 이 광기에 휩싸인 피바람의 중심에는, 태산(太山)과도 같은 기세로 쏘아지는 괴물이 있었다.

findings.current: Across a dozen yards that vanished in an instant, his Red Blade carved a massive line of blood-red light.
findings.defect: More than ten jang is over a hundred feet, not a dozen yards.
findings.rationale: The distance defines the closing movement at the chapter’s final clash.
findings.replacement: Across more than a hundred feet of space that vanished in an instant, his Red Blade carved a massive line of blood-red light.
findings.source: 단숨에 지워지는 십여 장의 공간 너머, 놈의 적도가 거대한 핏빛 선을 그렸다.

summary: The draft reverses the Blood Lord’s guarded demeanor and misstates the cause of the defenders’ fear. It also compresses several battlefield distances.
